versions.name: Camp Binachi
versions.summary: A long-established Scouts BSA resident camp in east-central Mississippi near Meridian, set on wooded acreage around Lake Frank Williams with a shooting sports center and summer camp program.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified via web search. The source labels this a Choctaw Area Council / 'Andrew Jackson Council' camp, but Choctaw Area Council and Andrew Jackson Council merged into the Mississippi Riverlands Council effective March 2026, which now operates Camp Binachi; the source's choctawareacouncil.org link is superseded. Ran a Scouts BSA summer camp in 2025. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, current council (post-merger Mississippi Riverlands), and operating status verified; classified as a Scouts BSA resident camp; features unsurveyed.
